description: This Java class 'BillingAccountWorker' provides utility methods for managing billing accounts, including retrieving account lists, calculating balances, and fetching open orders within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: BillingAccountWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for billing account operations within OFBiz.

classes.name: BillingAccountComparator
classes.description: Comparator for sorting billing accounts by account balance.

methods.name: makePartyBillingAccountList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of billing accounts related to a party, filtered by currency and role.

methods.name: getBillingAccountOpenOrders
methods.description: Fetches open orders associated with a billing account.

methods.name: getBillingAccountAvailableBalance
methods.description: Calculates the available balance for a billing account, considering account limit and current balance.

methods.name: getBillingAccountNetBalance
methods.description: Calculates net balance of a billing account based on applied payments and invoices.

methods.name: availableToCapture
methods.description: Determines the amount available for capture on a billing account.

methods.name: calcBillingAccountBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns billing account balances and related info as a service.
